content:
The **Charleston Capitol Courthouse** is a part of the Capitol Building complex in Charleston.

The south part of the main building is a wing that centers around the partially collapsed courthouse. The roof leads to the press briefing and conference room upstairs, which were converted into a triage and cooking area after the war. Adjacent to the courthouse is the Office of the Registrar and the Capitol Police offices, which include a small jail with holding cells and Rosalynn Jeffries, killed by the flood intended to avenge her apparent death. It's also a major stop during Key to the Past.

In the back is the judge's office, which contains the location's steamer trunk and another locked safe. Upon entering from the western side of the building through a blue door in the area between two buildings, the player character is immediately met with Cutthroats decorations, including a Responder Corpse, before turning left into another room. This was a reception area, with fencing and raider barricades added post-War. Heading south, there are two bathrooms: one on the right, while the one on the left has a hole in the wall leading to a larger room with a podium and discarded pews.

This leads into a hallway, from which one can access an office area converted into a clinic, with a Chemistry Station and some medical equipment. The nearby staircase only leads downward, as the way up is blocked by rubble.

Downstairs is a state courtroom, where the Cutthroats have stacked the main desk and chair on top of debris to create a mountain, looking down at a single chair where another Responded corpse lies. To the north is a side office containing the crime log terminal, and a camera pointed at a mannequin. Above the mannequin is chalk writing that reads "DUMM ASS."

Continuing north through a red door, there is an interrogation room with a jail cell and the corpse of Rosalynn Jeffries. Another hole in the wall opens up to the same hallway that led into the courtroom, just on the other side of a barrier. An area to the northwest was being used as a supply room. Several voter services terminals are here, as well. The black double doors at the end of the hallway are an exit. This section of the exterior is buried under a tunnel, and a button-operated exterior gate provides access to a wrecked bus that will lead back out to Charleston.

This location was originally part of one large interior with the rest of the capitol building, but it was split in order to accommodate for better navigation. The capitol building is recommended for level 30+, while the courthouse building is lower with a 15+ recommendation.

The Charleston Capitol Courthouse appears in *Fallout 76*.
